name: Epidural stimulation outcomes stratified by objectively measured spared connectivity

design.model: chronic clinically motor-complete spinal cord injury
design.intervention: standard epidural stimulation and training protocol
design.comparator: stratification, not randomisation: participants grouped by spared descending connectivity on high-resolution imaging and evoked potentials
design.readout: volitional movement below the lesion, over-ground walking, autonomic measures

discriminates: If benefit tracks spared connectivity, stimulation is an amplifier and regeneration remains necessary; if participants with no measurable sparing benefit equally, the spinal circuitry is doing more than the field assumes.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
